entries.subject: A sampled Gaia spectrum for the colour lens
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 releases externally calibrated sampled spectra only for the brighter sources; TRAPPIST-1 at G = 15.62 carries only the continuous basis-function coefficients (has_xp_sampled false, has_xp_continuous true). The coefficients are pinned and sampled here with GaiaXPy onto the archive's own grid, which is the same calibration the sampled product uses.

entries.subject: Imagery of the photosphere
entries.finding: No image of this star's disc exists or is expected: at 12.47 pc it is about 0.07 milliarcseconds across, far below any interferometer's reach. The colour lens is its own measured spectrum.

entries.subject: JWST measurements of the planets
entries.finding: 393 public JWST observations of this system are in MAST, including MIRI imaging time series of the planets' eclipses (programs 1177, 1279, 2304) and thermal phase curves of b and c (program 3077). Six segments of program 3077 were reduced from raw with this project's pipeline and Bell's deposited control files: correlation 0.9953 with his published light curve over the same 300 integrations, difference 223 ppm against a per-point scatter of 862 ppm (ours) and 891 ppm (his). The thermal lens itself is not in this package yet.
